source.title: No Good Deed Goes Unpunished
source.description: With that, I fear that you've outlived your usefulness. Don't worry though, I'd not dream of letting your service go unrewarded, so I'm going to bestow the honor of being devoured by me in my true form. It's really quite the honor, <class>.
source.completion:
Please, <class>. Accept my apologies for this mistreatment. You've done us a great service. Not only have you dealt a crushing blow against the black dragonflight, but you've recovered a dangerous weapon that could have been used to dominate all dragonkind.

I assure you, unlike my wayward brother, I pay the debts that are owed to my flight.
